metadata.title: Common Shade — Sri Lanka heat resilience snapshot
metadata.review_design: Targeted primary-source landscape with selected long-document sections, not exhaustive systematic review or legal audit
metadata.no_endorsement: Listing implies neither partnership nor endorsement; no organisation ranking
metadata.facts_and_interpretation: Evidence describes published findings/status. Taxonomy links, could_contribute and proposals are researcher interpretations, not commitments.
metadata.institution_tags: Functional nearest website category, not legal mandate. University research uses health or intl because supplied institution list has no research category.

evidence_labels.concept: Designed, not yet tried by intended users
evidence_labels.reported: Programme team/news description, not independently evaluated
evidence_labels.measured: Study, survey or analysis measured it

metadata.missing_data: null means not verified/not disclosed, never zero
metadata.independent_heat_programme_effects: No listed programme classified evaluated. This is a limit of collected evidence, not proof no evaluation exists.
metadata.retrieval: Web retrieval plus direct downloads of official PDFs; see source review notes.

country.name: Sri Lanka
country.scope: Targeted primary-source review; eight documented heat-concern city cases, not verified nationally top-ranked cities.

city_selection.method: Combine original thermal/station studies, official2026 provincial/district advisories, documented local work and building-climate context. No comparable national city hazard/exposure/vulnerability ranking verified.
city_selection.selection_limit: Colombo has deeper urban evidence than several regional cases. Broad regional warnings only establish concern in parts of the region, not the whole city.

heat_context.known: Humid heat and increasing warm nights are documented. Building-code warm-dry zones are not a guarantee of low humidity.
heat_context.inferred: Use location/season/workload-specific assessment and include recovery at home/night.
heat_context.uncertain: Comparable current ward-level exposure, health burden and national city ranking.

plans_and_legal_basis.legal_status: Published national climate commitment; HHAP listed as a proposed health plan
2023 health table assigns EOH leadership and records draft HHAP baseline; target completion is not proof of adoption
GGGI September2026 account says before Cabinet. Later approval not verified; full text not reviewed
Cabinet briefing22June2026 records approved proposal; page subject to next-meeting confirmation, actual delivery not verified
Launch verified4June2026; full roadmap and funded heat protocol not verified
Pre2015 foundational legal background. DMC governance/planning/finance functions; current heat-specific authorisation and amendments require local legal check
Pre2015 foundation contains reasonable-temperature provision; current inspectorate lists2021 amendment. Not a complete consolidated heat-safety legal audit
Final official linked edition first printed2021 reviewed; scope-specific energy requirements, not universal heat-health safety certification
Official draft reviewed; final adoption instrument not verified. NCAP publication support is a separate programme claim

responsibilities.local_delivery: City/district/divisional/public-health responsibilities to confirm case by case

warnings.metric: Heat Index from forecast temperature and relative humidity; not maximum air temperature, workplace WBGT or measured illness
warnings.non_smartphone_delivery: Official documents include public/jobsite/home advice and archive has language versions. Tested radio/loudspeaker/door-to-door receipt and action reach not verified. Propose those channels only after local agreement.

occupational_rules.verified_background: Section11 reasonable workroom temperature and ministerial power for regulations; inspectorate role.
occupational_rules.legal_audit_limit: Current regulations, amendments, scope, sector rules and enforcement not fully checked; null is not a claim there is no duty.
occupational_rules.inclusion: Factory provisions cannot be assumed to reach all street vendors, gig workers, farmers or domestic workers.

cooling.approach: Proposed passive-first design assessment combined with appropriate active cooling and reliable operations.
cooling.climate_suitability: Shade/envelope/ventilation design to match actual humidity, night air, security and air quality; code warm-dry designation is not a psychrometric equipment rule. No universal evaporative or fan-use prescription supplied.
cooling.cooling_trap: Loop cooling: consider peak electricity, waste heat, refrigerants, affordable operation and power-cut fallback alongside access.

costs.reason: No verified local comparable intervention lifecycle cost with published FX found; no global price substituted.

cooling.affordability: Income share, tariff-specific bills, landlord permission and maintenance burden not verified; propose measurement before procurement.
cooling.policy_cautions: Standard existence, label programme, code scope, gazette enforceability, product availability and compliance are separate facts.

entry_points.proposal: Colombo worker-led shade, water/toilets, paid rest and home/night protection package
Local warning-to-action drill aligned with health/DMC actors, disability access and non-phone channels
Costed ward/facility portfolios linked to national/provincial planning, with separate operating budgets and maintenance
Dry Zone urban–rural heat/water/worker learning without assuming a single CKDu cause

assessment_questions: Can a worker rest without lost income or retaliation?
Are women, pregnant people, older people and people with disabilities able to reach and use services?
Who owns roofs/land and can cooling improvements raise rents or displace residents?
Will shade or tree cover block needed airflow, and who pays for water/upkeep?
Are fans/AC usable during outages, with safe wiring and affordable bills?
Do sensors collect only necessary data, with consent and a real protective action?
equity_and_maladaptation.interpretation: Researcher design questions, not claims these harms occurred in every selected city.

country.known: Official forecast advisories, policy commitments, primary research and real funded research/technical programmes exist.
country.inferred: Common Shade can connect these to locally agreed operational packages and maintained public capability.
country.uncertain: Final plan approvals, current legal schedules, present city budgets, open eligibility, unit costs and independent heat-protection outcomes.

sources.title: Urban thermal comfort trends in Sri Lanka
sources.review_note: Original paper, selected methods/results reviewed. Methods use 20 stations over 1996–2020 after missing-data filtering, despite broader dates in abstract. RayMan-derived UTCI and Colombo design scenarios are modelled, not direct clinical/indoor measurements. No UTCI-to-WBGT equivalence reused.

sources.title: Recent Trends in Climate Extreme Indices over Sri Lanka
sources.review_note: Original Department of Meteorology-authored station analysis; selected methods and findings reviewed. Nineteen stations, 1980–2015; increasing warm nights and minimum temperatures, not a 2026 city ranking.

sources.title: DMC weather report archive
sources.review_note: Official archive opened; original HTML used to resolve links. Historical heat advisories and Tamil-language listings verified, not present-day warning or proven household receipt.

sources.title: Warm Weather Advisory issued 25 April 2026
sources.review_note: Official PDF downloaded directly and English text extracted after web-reader access failure. Forecast Caution in parts of several provinces; heat index explicitly not maximum air temperature. No image-table numerical threshold reused.

sources.title: Warm Weather Advisory issued 22 August 2026
sources.review_note: Official PDF downloaded directly; English advisory reviewed. Eastern/North Central provinces and Jaffna, Kilinochchi, Vavuniya, Mullaitivu and Monaragala districts. Parts of regions forecast, not city-level observed exposure.

sources.title: Warm Weather Advisory issued 19 October 2026
sources.review_note: Official PDF downloaded directly; English text reviewed. Northern, North Central, Eastern, North Western provinces and Monaragala/Hambantota districts. Next-day numerical-weather-model-derived heat index, not maximum air temperature. Historical, not a live alert on check date.

sources.title: NDC Implementation Plan 2021–2030
sources.review_note: Selected health section PDF page 232 reviewed. Identifies EOH Directorate and draft HHAP baseline/2023 target. Target does not prove completion. Read alongside newer NDC 3.0.

sources.title: Sri Lanka NDC 3.0, 2026–2035
sources.review_note: Primary submitted government document, selected health/urban/implementation sections reviewed. Health section still describes HHAP among proposed plans. Climate commitment, not evidence of approved funded operational HHAP or legal cash entitlement.

sources.title: Cabinet decision on El Niño coordination committees
sources.review_note: Official Cabinet briefing says proposal approved; page marked subject to confirmation at next meeting. Committees and action-plan formulation described; operating delivery/budget releases not verified.

sources.title: Sri Lanka Disaster Management Act No.13 of 2005
sources.review_note: Primary government legal document; selected governance, DMC and planning/finance provisions reviewed. Pre-2015 foundational legal background; current amendments and heat-specific authorisation/eligibility not fully audited.

sources.title: Department of Labour Industrial Safety Division
sources.review_note: Official current functions page identifies Factories Ordinance enforcement, inspectorate and 2021 amendment. Not evidence all workplaces inspected or a complete current heat standard.

sources.title: Factories Ordinance — primary legal text mirrored by EFC
sources.review_note: Selected primary legal text reviewed, including section 11 reasonable workroom temperature. Pre-2015 legal background on employer-federation mirror. Not current consolidated law; 2021 amendment and regulations require checking before operational use.

sources.title: Energy Efficiency Building Code of Sri Lanka
sources.review_note: Final linked official edition, selected scope/envelope/HVAC/foreword reviewed. Separate 2020-filename PDF is marked DRAFT and not used as final. Code applies by building/system scope and says energy performance does not cover all health/safety. Local enforcement/gazette status not fully audited.

sources.title: SLSEA introducing standards
sources.review_note: Official page distinguishes appliance standards, regulations and programme progress; final code linked. Ceiling-fan label listed mandatory; air-conditioner programme described in progress, so no blanket mandatory AC labelling claim. Undated page may lag legal changes.

sources.title: National Cooling Policy — ministry draft
sources.review_note: Primary 22-page policy document, selected thermal comfort/implementation sections reviewed. Ministry public-comment listing corroborates draft context; final adoption instrument not verified. Proposed requirements not treated as current law.

sources.title: UNDP summary of National Cooling Action Plans
sources.review_note: Primary programme summary says Sri Lanka among countries with published NCAPs supported by UNDP/Clean Cooling Collaborative. Publication/development does not establish adoption of the separate National Cooling Policy.

sources.title: UNEP Ozone Secretariat — Sri Lanka country profile
sources.publication_date: Live profile; funding list as of 2026-06-26
sources.review_note: Treaty ratification/licensing and Multilateral Fund mechanisms reviewed. Kigali ratification 28 September 2018. Restricted compliance assistance, not open general heat adaptation grants.

sources.title: UNDP Digital Cooling Project
sources.review_note: Primary project page names Denmark/Luxembourg and NOU/SLSEA, survey and planned pilot. Expected savings are targets. Page says ongoing despite elapsed narrative dates and displays a separate broader project widget; status conflict retained, amounts not conflated.

sources.title: SLRCS/IFRC air-quality and heat-stress convening
sources.review_note: Primary convenor account names Meteorology, CEA, MSF South Asia and NBRO. Meeting participation is not a funded heat-response programme, current partnership mandate or independently evaluated protection.

sources.title: UNFPA extreme heat exposure guideline procurement background
sources.review_note: Primary notice describes proposed gender-responsive community guideline/communication materials and MoH/DMC consultation. Commissioning intent, not a completed adopted guideline or award announcement.

sources.title: UNGM UNFPA-LKA-00013 tender
sources.review_note: Primary procurement notice. Deadline 19 October 2026 00:29 GMT-4 marked expired. Procurement route Quantum/basic registration; not an open philanthropy grant. Dates differ from later UNFPA webpage posting, retained separately.

sources.title: Heat stress in Colombo: understanding impacts and planning for the future
sources.review_note: Original Centre for a Smart Future brief: 50 qualitative interviews, May 2024–March 2025, six Colombo sites, selected methods/findings reviewed. Purposive/qualitative evidence, not population prevalence, physiological WBGT measurement or causal evaluation. Secondary climate numbers and index conflation not repeated.

sources.title: SLYCAN heat stress/gender-sensitive planning — Colombo fieldwork
sources.review_note: Primary implementer account of Modara/Mattakkuliya fieldwork and APN-supported regional work. Sample/effect magnitude not independently verified. Planned outputs not assumed adopted.

sources.title: Meeting with Colombo Municipal Council on gender-sensitive heat plans
sources.review_note: Four-page original meeting record reviewed. CMC/DoM/IRADe/SLYCAN links, local-data and training needs. Not municipal plan approval or proof current appointee remains in post.

sources.title: APN CBA2021-07SY-Magotra final report
sources.review_note: Original grant report, selected outputs and funding sections reviewed. USD40,000 regional award, not Sri Lanka allocation or unit cost. Framework/training outputs not statutory HAP adoption. Collaborator country labels contain errors; corrected using primary Sri Lanka account, not copied.

sources.title: Temporal and spatial heat exposure in Colombo — COSMA dataset
sources.review_note: Primary creator dataset description reviewed; GIS files not reanalysed. 500m SUEWS-model-derived indicators and anthropogenic heat flux. Includes evening/night time slices; event month omitted in metadata, so exact event dates not reconstructed. Not current live exposure or individual health risk.

sources.title: Closing Heat Data Gaps in Climate Disease Frontline Communities
sources.review_note: Primary university project account reports stations deployed in Padawiya, Matara and Jaffna with local university collaborators; manuscript in progress. Equipment deployment not a proven kidney-disease cause or prevention effect.

sources.title: Occupational heat exposure alone does not explain CKDu in Sri Lanka
sources.review_note: Original-author university record provides study abstract; publisher full text inaccessible. Cross-occupational observational study; fisherfolk, paddy farmers and plantation workers. Counters single-cause heat attribution without proving heat harmless or identifying one definitive cause.

sources.title: Workplace health and safety under climate stress in Sri Lankan apparel SMEs
sources.review_note: Original full article, selected methods/results reviewed. 384 questionnaire responses from six factories in Biyagama/Katunayake, October 2023–March 2024. English-language and tenure eligibility constrain inclusion. Self-reports, not physiological exposure or causal retrofit effects; raw prevalence estimates not reused.

sources.title: The Heat is On! Towards a Climate Resilient Education System in Sri Lanka
sources.review_note: UNICEF-commissioned original mixed documentary/qualitative study; selected methods/education findings reviewed. Interviews, school FGDs and youth input in 2020–2021, not a current government closure order or measured cooling intervention.

sources.title: Climate Resilient Integrated Water Management Project
sources.review_note: Primary implementer page lists completed status and GCF finance; water/irrigation/safe-drinking-water resilience. Heat protection relevance is analytical/adjacent; not direct measured cooling or kidney-disease prevention. Original GCF pages returned 403.

sources.title: Dry Zone regional drought workshop field visit
sources.review_note: Primary UNDP account of Anuradhapura/Polonnaruwa field sites and GCF-funded CRIWMP. Site reports are not independent effect estimates or proof citywide service coverage.

sources.title: GGGI account of forthcoming NAP and financing preparation
sources.review_note: Primary technical delivery partner account says NAP2026–2035 before Cabinet and describes costed sector/provincial planning. Later approval not verified. CANOPI fund is proposed; no operating grant route inferred. Full NAP/finance rules not appraised.

sources.title: ILO resilient plantations — safety, health and livelihood recovery
sources.review_note: Primary ILO project page verifies Japan/SSN Fund support and includes extreme heat among plantation OSH risks. Broader recovery/OSH project, not heat-only or independently evaluated heat intervention.

sources.title: ILO heat stress, jobs and productivity — six-country study event
sources.review_note: Primary scheduled event page verifies commissioned Sri Lanka study among six countries; CVF–V20 Joint Multi-Donor Fund support and University of Thessaly team. Event not yet held at check date, numerical study findings not reviewed; precise time not verified.

sources.title: National Health Policy Review 2022 — climate-change focal point
sources.review_note: Full PDF retrieved directly and selected climate focal-point section read (PDF page 232). Identifies EOH Directorate, MOH/PHI local delivery, health adaptation work and draft HHAP. Historical status, not evidence of 2026 approval.

sources.title: Sri Lanka National Anticipatory Action Roadmap 2026–2030 launch
sources.review_note: Official Ministry of Defence launch account names DMC/WFP and participating agencies. Roadmap announcement does not verify a funded operational heat protocol, trigger, cash entitlement or open grant. Full roadmap not retrieved.
